Claims
------

CLAIMS We Claim: 

1. A compound of F ormul a I :

[![Figure imgf000123_0001](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/80/c9/a5/46068c5f557db7/imgf000123_0001.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/80/c9/a5/46068c5f557db7/imgf000123_0001.png)

I

or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein:

X1 is N or C-Rxl;

X2 is N or C-Rx2;

X3 is N or C-Rx3;

X4 is N or C-Rx4;

provided that one or two of X1, X2, X3 and X4 is N;

each of Rxl, Rx2, Rx3, and Rx4 is independently selected from -R or -OR;

L1 is selected from a covalent bond, -0-, -N(R)-, -C(0)N(R)-, -S(0)2-, and -S(0)2N(R)-;

L2 is selected from a covalent bond, -0-, -N(R)-, -N(R)C(0)-, and -N(R)S(0)2-;

R1 is selected from halogen, CN, and -R;

R2 is -R; and

R is selected from hydrogen or an optionally substituted group selected from Ci-6 aliphatic, phenyl, a 4- to 6-membered heterocyclic ring having 1-2 heteroatoms independently selected from nitrogen, oxygen, or sulfur, a 5- to 6-membered heteroaryl ring having 1-3 heteroatoms independently selected from nitrogen, oxygen, or sulfur, and an 8- to 10- membered heteroaryl ring having 1-3 heteroatoms independently selected from nitrogen, oxygen, or sulfur.

2 The compound according to claim 1, wherein the compound is selected from:

I-a I-b I-c or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

3. The compound according to claim 1, wherein the compound is:

I-d

or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

4. The compound according to claim 3, wherein the compound is selected from:

I-a-/ I-b-/ I-c-/ or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

5. The compound according to claim 4, wherein the compound is selected from:

I-a-w I-b-H I-C-H or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

6. The compound according to claim 1, wherein the compound is selected from:

[![Figure imgf000125_0002](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/b2/ef/89/8d2bba1f768618/imgf000125_0002.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/b2/ef/89/8d2bba1f768618/imgf000125_0002.png)

1-c-iii I-c-iv I-c-v or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

7. A method comprising a step of:

administering a compound of any one of claims 1-6 to a subject who (i) has a condition characterized by axonal degeneration or (ii) is at risk of developing a condition characterized by axonal degeneration.

8. A method of treating or preventing axonal degeneration comprising administering to a subject in need thereof a compound of any one of claims 1-6.

9. A method of inhibiting SARM1 comprising contacting a biological sample with a compound of any one of claims 1-6.
